subject_uz: O'zbektelekom binolarida yakunlangan qurilish-montaj ishlari bo'yicha nazorat-o'lchov xizmatlari (28 ta obyekt)

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat respublika bo'ylab 28 ta qurilishi tugallangan obyektda (umumiy qurilish qiymati 187,1 mlrd so'm) ko'rsatiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Services cover 28 completed construction sites across the country (total construction value 187.1 bn UZS).
requirements.quote: Umumiy qurilish qiymati 187,1 mlrd. so'm bo'lgan 28 ta obyekt.

requirements.summary_uz: Qurilish obyektlarida nazorat o'lchovi huquqini tasdiqlovchi akkreditatsiya mavjud bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: An accreditation confirming the right to carry out control measurements on construction sites is required.

requirements.summary_uz: Shtatda kamida 3 yillik stajli va 'Qurilishda nazorat o'lchovi va hisob-kitob mutaxassisi' sertifikatli kamida 1 xodim bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: At least one employee with 3 years' experience and a 'construction control-measurement and estimating specialist' certificate must be on staff.
requirements.quote: Shtatida kamida 3 yil ish stajiga ega 1 ta “Qurilishda nazorat o'lchovi va hisob-kitob mutaxassisi” sertifikatiga ega bo'lgan xodim mavjud bo'lishi

requirements.summary_uz: Mutaxassislar uchun ball: 3 va undan ko'p diplomli, 3 yil tajribali, sertifikatli mutaxassis bo'lsa 3 ball (1 ta bo'lsa 1 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Specialists score: 3 or more with diploma, 3 years' experience and certificate gives 3 points (1 specialist gives 1 point).
requirements.quote: 3 nafar va undan ortiq mutaxassis tegishli diplomga, kamida 3 yil ish tajribasiga va amaldagi nazorat-o‘lchov sertifikatiga ega bo‘lsa – 3 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Tajriba bo'yicha ball: 5 va undan ko'p yakunlangan o'xshash shartnoma 3 ball, 3-4 ta 2 ball, 2 tagacha 1 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Experience score: 5 or more completed similar contracts give 3 points, 3-4 give 2, up to 2 give 1.
requirements.quote: 5 ta va undan ortiq yakunlangan shartnomani tashkil etsa — 3 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Malaka-texnik qism 8 balldan iborat; 4 balldan kam to'plagan takliflar narx bosqichiga o'tmaydi, so'ng eng past narx g'olib bo'ladi.
requirements.summary_en: The qualification-technical part is worth 8 points; bids under 4 points do not go on to the price stage, and the lowest price then wins.
requirements.quote: Tanlov ishtirokchilarining malaka-texnik baholashidan o‘ta olmagan (baholash natijalari bo‘yicha 4 balldan kam ball to‘plagan) takliflari

requirements.summary_uz: Har bir talabnoma bo'yicha rasmiylashtirilgan dalolatnomalar 15 ish kuni ichida topshiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Formal measurement acts must be handed over within 15 working days of each request.
requirements.quote: Buyurtmachi tomonidan talabnoma taqdim etilgan kundan so'ng 15 (o'n besh) ish kuni mobaynida Xizmat ko'rsatuvchi tashkilot

requirements.summary_uz: Buyurtmachi bildirgan kamchiliklar 5 ish kuni ichida bartaraf etilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Defects raised by the customer must be corrected within 5 working days.
requirements.quote: Xizmat ko'rsatish jarayonida Buyurtmachi tomonidan bildirilgan kamchiliklarni 5 (besh) ish kuni mobaynida bartaraf qilish

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma qiymatining 30 foizi avans, qolgani har oy bajarilgan xizmatlar bo'yicha to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: 30% advance of the contract value; the rest is paid monthly against services delivered.
requirements.quote: Shartnoma umumiy qiymatining 30 % (o‘ttiz) miqdorida oldindan to‘lov (avans)

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy va kadrlar resurslari mavjudligi haqida kafolat xati (rasmiy blankda).
requirements.summary_en: Guarantee letter on the availability of technical, financial, material and staff resources (on letterhead).
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi tomonidan shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur bo‘lgan texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy-texnik, kadrlar hamda boshqa

documents_needed_uz: Resurslar mavjudligi haqida kafolat xati (rasmiy blankda)
Ustav nusxasi, rahbarni tayinlash buyrug'i yoki ishonchnoma
Soliq organidan muddati o'tgan qarz yo'qligi ma'lumotnomasi
Bankrotlik (to'lovga layoqatsizlik) tartib-taomili yo'qligi haqida my.gov.uz dan olingan hujjat
Insofsiz ijrochilar reyestrida yo'qligi haqida ma'lumot
Majburiy ijro byurosi ma'lumotlar bazasida bajarilmagan majburiyat yo'qligi haqida ma'lumot
Manfaatlar to'qnashuvi yoki affillanganlik yo'qligi haqida ariza (1-sonli shakl)
Buyurtmachi bilan oldingi shartnomalar bo'yicha kafolat xati (3-sonli shakl)
Ish tajribasi to'g'risida ma'lumot, shartnoma va hisob-faktura nusxalari (4-sonli shakl)
Mutaxassislar ro'yxati, diplom va sertifikatlar, my.mehnat.uz dan ko'chirma yoki jalb qilish shartnomalari
Taklifning xarid hujjatlariga muvofiqligi haqida kafolat xati (5-sonli shakl)
Ta'sis hujjatlari va davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik guvohnomasi
